g.text: UC-18 / UC-19 · Structures named in in-game mails reach the Structures page, the Search tab and the Wars lists
in-game: drag a structure link and its owner corporation's link into a mail
the mail is sent to a character that granted esi-mail.read_mail.v1
hourly scout run (after the dock search) or Resolve unknown (first, forced)
[each character with the mail scope that is due (mail_refresh_minutes, 60)]
[up to mail_max_pages (4), while the page is new and younger than mail_max_age_days (30)]
50 headers (mail_id, timestamp; subject, sender and recipients are ignored)
mail_reads: skip mails already parsed (mail IDs are global); scout_mail.last_mail_id
[structure_id, type_id, name, owner_id] (body dropped, nothing else kept)
structure_mail_finds (newer mail replaces, older fills gaps), known_structures (status new), mail_reads
a scan that stored finds bumps version (effective() and index() are rebuilt)
passing errors (0, 420, 429, 5xx) keep the character due; 401 / 403 wait the whole interval;
the scan stops at 60 ESI errors left and on cancel
the structure is read with ESI as usual
token of a character that has assets there (or the main)
name, owner_id, solar_system_id, type_id (403: next character, 404: gone)
UPDATE known_structures (live ESI data wins over the mail find)
open Structures (Shared list, source "named in mails") or Search
rows: live ESI > mail find > public datasets (mail: date, owner)
rows with jumps, "Named in a mail" and known / unknown
Wars page, Structures at war tab
index() (structures with owner and system, mail finds included)
structures of both sides of active wars in all space
